_comment: Authoritative machine-readable asset provenance record for VOWED.
Written at acquisition time, never retroactively. See docs/ASSET_LICENSES.md.
An asset present in the project but absent here is treated as unlicensed
and must not ship. The in-game credits screen is generated from this file,
so the register and the credits cannot drift apart.

_entry_schema.id: stable kebab-case identifier, referenced by import scripts
_entry_schema.name: human-readable asset name
_entry_schema.creator: author or studio, as they wish to be credited
_entry_schema.url: direct URL of the exact asset page whose licence was read
_entry_schema.license: SPDX identifier where one exists, else exact licence name
_entry_schema.license_url: URL of the licence terms as they stood at acquisition
files: repo-relative paths of every file from this asset
_entry_schema.modifications: what was changed (retarget, rescale, reauthored materials), or 'none'
_entry_schema.attribution_text: exact credit line to render, when required
_entry_schema.commercial_use: boolean — must be true to ship
_entry_schema.notes: anything a future reader needs, e.g. 'pack mixes licences'

assets.name: Universal Animation Library (Standard / free tier)
assets.creator: Quaternius (Tom Laulhet)
assets.modifications: none yet; animations are retimed at runtime by seeking to the combat frame counter rather than being re-exported
assets.notes: CC0 verified on the creator's own itch.io page and in the bundled LICENSE file (CC0 1.0 Universal full text), not from a search snippet. Obtained via the CC0 mirror at github.com/J-Ponzo/gltf-universal-animation-library, which CC0 expressly permits; the canonical source is the itch.io page above. Bundles a rigged 'Mannequin' mesh (53 joints, Rigify DEF- naming, 1.83 m) used as the project's graybox character. FREE TIER ONLY: 46 animations. Contains NO kick animations, which is half this game's input language - see docs/ASSET_LICENSES.md.

assets.name: Impact Sounds (curated subset)
assets.creator: Kenney (kenney.nl)
assets.modifications: none; a curated subset of the 130-file pack. Variant selection and pitch variation are applied at runtime, the files themselves are unmodified.
assets.notes: CC0 verified on kenney.nl AND in the License.txt bundled with the download, archived at assets/licenses/kenney_impact_sounds_CC0.txt. Only the categories combat actually uses were imported (8 of 26) rather than the whole pack - every file in assets/ must be registered, so importing unused files is licence bookkeeping with no benefit. 5 variants per category, which matters: one punch sound repeated through a combo is worse than none.
